visuals.title: Effective monthly price by tier — annual vs monthly billing

visuals.section: NSFW AI companion without crypto payment required
visuals.what: Payment-friction contrast: card-payment lane flowing straight to 'start chatting' vs crypto-only lane blocked by a wall before the same destination.
visuals.art_director_note: Accepted on first generation (0 retries). Title correct; top 'Card payment' lane shows a generic card icon (no numbers, no brand marks) with a smooth blue arrow into a 'start chatting' chat bubble; bottom 'Crypto-only' lane shows a generic amber coin (no currency symbol, no logo) whose grey arrow is stopped by a brick-wall barrier before an unreachable 'start chatting' bubble; no logos, no internal-tool names. Upscaled 1024->1400 lossless for the >=1200px bar.
visuals.alt: Editorial comparison diagram titled Two ways to pay to start: a Card payment lane runs a credit-card icon straight into a chat bubble labeled start chatting, while a Crypto-only lane runs a coin-token icon into a brick-wall barrier blocking the path to the same chat bubble.
visuals.reason_added: Eternal AI / payment-friction section is the article's information-gain angle and had no visual; a labeled contrast diagram makes the card-vs-crypto-wall point faster than the prose and adds type-diverse value to a section that previously read as unbroken prose.
